description: Starts inviting investors to one of the user’s funds by email address. The assistant resolves the fund, asks for what is missing, and puts the invitations to the user for confirmation before any is sent.

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York
